page: Google Cloud Platform c4-highmem-96 is a memory-optimized server instance powered by the x86_64 architecture. It features 96 dedicated virtual CPUs, mapped from 48 physical cores of an Intel Xeon 8581C processor operating at 2.3 GHz. The system is equipped with 744 GB of RAM, providing a high memory-to-vCPU ratio of 7.75 GB per core. The processor includes a 260 MB L3 cache and supports advanced instruction sets, including Intel Advanced Vector Extensions (AVX-512) and Advanced Matrix Extensions (AMX) for accelerated matrix operations. No local storage or GPUs are bundled with this instance.

Benchmark evaluations indicate strong multi-core performance and memory throughput. The instance achieves top-tier results in Geekbench single-core and multi-core tests, alongside high throughput in static web serving at 128.55 GB/sec. Memory bandwidth is highly efficient, reaching 288.74 GB/sec for large-block read operations. Cryptographic performance is also notable, with the Passmark CPU encryption test placing in the top tier. For machine learning workloads, the hardware-assisted AMX instructions enable strong LLM inference prompt processing speeds, reaching 297.98 tokens/sec on medium 7B models.

From a resource density perspective, the c4-highmem-96 offers a qualitative balance between high-capacity memory and dedicated compute resources. The absence of integrated local NVMe storage requires reliance on network-attached storage, which may introduce latency tradeoffs for I/O-heavy operations. However, the high memory allocation per core makes it a cost-efficient alternative to deploying larger, more expensive compute-heavy instances when memory capacity is the primary bottleneck.

This configuration is highly suited for memory-intensive enterprise applications, large-scale database operations, and software compilation. It is also well-suited for CPU-based machine learning inference, high-throughput web serving, and data-processing pipelines that benefit from a large memory footprint and dedicated Intel Xeon processing power.
